title: What xAI's Grok build CLI sends to xAI: A wire-level analysis #Shorts
description:
A developer ran a wire-level analysis on xAI's Grok CLI and published exactly what it sends home — and the Hacker News community lit up with 441 points of concern. If you use any AI vendor CLI tool in your dev environment, now is a good time to run your own traffic audit with Wireshark or mitmproxy before it touches anything sensitive.

#grok #xai #developertools #networksecurity #cli #coding #infosec #techanalysis #Shorts
